name: A repeated command that is no longer legal is rejected and changes nothing
title: SC-08-12-07 A repeated command that is no longer legal is rejected and changes nothing
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given Unit "A Blok 14" is VACANT after a move-out
When the Site Manager sends the same move-out again and then a second owner takes back
Then each request is rejected naming the current state
And the occupancy history, ownership rows, status and audit trail are unchanged
